content.rendered:
Applying for Free or Reduced Meals:

To be eligible for Free or Reduced Meals, complete a Free or Reduced Meals application.  One application per household is required annually for eligibility.

 

For a printable form, please click the links below. Fill out the application and return to your student’s school or mail to: 23295 SW Main St Sherwood OR 97140. Attn:  Kelly Rood

Application 2018-2019 English

Application 2018-2019 Español

Permission to Share Form:

In order to be eligible for other benefits, (such as reduced student fees, athletic fees, etc.) complete a Permission to Share Form (Permiso para Compartir Información )

To request an application in Russian or Vietnamese, please contact:

Kelly Rood

Phone: (503) 825-5027

Fax: (503) 825-5001

Email
